story.overview: Unify tool transparency (Sources) and document-level citations (Anthropic Citations API) into a single professional References footer block. Remove emojis from sources display for enterprise appearance. Enable Claude's Citations API for document blocks to provide verifiable claim-to-source mapping.
story.user-story: As a Slack user, I want Orion to display professional, unified source references that show both tool transparency AND document-level citations, so that I can verify where information comes from and trust Orion's responses are grounded in real sources.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Enable `citations: { enabled: true }` on document content blocks. Parse citation blocks from Claude's response (`type: 'cite'` in content array). Extract `cited_text`, `document_index`, `start_char_index`, `end_char_index` from citation blocks. Handle responses that have no citations gracefully (backwards compatible).

Remove all emojis from `src/slack/sources-block.ts` output. Replace current "Sources:" header with `*References:*` (Slack bold). Tool references format: `[n] Tool Name: Action - "query"` (no emoji prefix). No visual distinction between tool sources and document citations in header.

Single Block Kit context block at end of responses. Combines both tool sources AND document citations in numbered list. Tool sources format: `[n] Tool Name: Action - "query"`. Document citations format: `[n] "cited excerpt..." - Document.pdf, page X` (if page available). Inline markers from Claude (`[1]`, `[2]`) link to footer entries.

When response includes document citations, Claude's inline `[n]` markers preserved. Document citations reference actual documents (PDF, uploaded files) not MCP tools. If no document citations but tool sources exist, show tool sources only. If both exist, merge into unified numbered list (tools first, then documents).
Event `citation.response` logged per response with: `tool_source_count`, `document_citation_count`, `citation_types` array. Track citation usage trends for quality metrics.
Existing tool-only responses (no document citations) continue to work. API responses without citation blocks handled gracefully. No breaking changes to existing `formatSourcesBlock()` callers.
Unit tests for citation parsing logic. Unit tests for unified references formatter. Integration test with mock citation response from Claude. Update `project-context.md` with citations configuration.

technical-notes.note: Citations is a GA feature - no beta header required. However, it is incompatible with Structured Outputs - cannot use both simultaneously.
Claude response includes `type: 'cite'` blocks with: cited_text (string), document_index (number), start_char_index (number), end_char_index (number).
Enable citations by adding `citations: { enabled: true }` property to document content blocks.
Use `*References:*` for bold (not `**References:**`). Links use `` format.
Both stories modify `src/agent/loop.ts`. Story 8.1 adds `documentCitations` to AgentLoopResult. Story 8.2 adds `defer_loading` to tool definitions. Changes can coexist.

relevant-sections.section: Epic 8 repurposed from "Code Generation (Phase 2)" to "Anthropic API Enhancements". Story 8.1 implements Citations API integration with priority P1.
Bold: `*text*` (NOT `**text**`). Links: `` (NOT `[text](url)`). This is Slack's mrkdwn format, not Markdown.
Every tool handler MUST wrap its entire body in try/catch. Return ToolResult with success/error, never throw.
Span naming: `{component}.{operation}`. Logging: Include traceId in every log entry. Langfuse: best-effort, never block response on trace flush.

patterns-to-follow.pattern: Always use `.js` extension for relative imports: `import { x } from './module.js'`
Tool errors return `ToolResult` with success/error, never throw.
Include `traceId` in every log entry. Use `logger.*` methods, not `console.log`.
Return Block Kit structures for Slack. Context blocks use `type: 'context'` with `elements` array.
Unit tests co-located with source files. Use Vitest framework.

code-examples.example: *References:* [1] MSCI Reports: Search - "Hulu" [2] Confluence: Search Pages - "onboarding" [3] "Q3 revenue grew 12% YoY" - MSCI_Hulu_Report.pdf [4] "User retention improved 5%" - Analytics_Summary.pdf

anti-patterns.anti-pattern: Do not keep emojis "for visual interest" - remove all for professional appearance
Do not create separate citation and source blocks - unify into single `*References:*` block
Do not hardcode document names - extract from document metadata or use placeholder
Do not fail if no citations - handle gracefully, tool sources still work
Do not log full cited text - log citation count and types only
Do not use `**bold**` or `[text](url)` - use Slack mrkdwn: `*bold*` and ``

constraints.constraint: Citations API cannot be used simultaneously with Structured Outputs
Citations is GA - no beta header required
Citations work on document content blocks, not tool results
Claude manages `[n]` markers in response text - preserve them
